en-US: Build 197 release candidate (1.7.0, reserved tag v1.7.0-beta.54, tag not yet created). No App cloud build, upload or device acceptance has happened yet; this is an internal test note for the candidate flows. Please focus on: (1) Mind maps: with a topic selected, Add child node / Add sibling node at the top-left must create the node and open its text editor immediately, with a finger and with Apple Pencil; missing selection, a center-topic sibling and a still-saving map must show explicit hints, and the change must stay undoable and saved. (2) Video: video.models now lists public model names and video.generate / canvas.generate may omit model so the current model picks a public candidate instead of asking you for a UUID; Ark video now reads the provider credential from the correct secret store. (3) Tool context: after several tool calls, restart the app and continue the same conversation - the model should remember earlier tool results, including across a context-compaction summary; persisted tool summaries are secret-redacted. (4) Execution environment: Settings shows real runtime versions with Bundled/Remote/User sources and real update states; apt installs report a real signed receipt or rejection per route. (5) Magic Keyboard: unmodified Return sends in the chat composer, Shift+Return inserts a newline, and Return never sends while an input method is composing; the canvas assistant keeps software Return sending. (6) Office: an existing or imported document previews read-only on first entry and opens the editor from the second entry onwards, while a document created now edits directly; in the IDE Office stays embedded in its tab with a Source control entry and Share; the file manager's expand action opens the fullscreen Office editor; cloud/network documents are read-only snapshots until downloaded to a local workspace; Pencil ink settings survive reopen. Also: the ineffective Add to canvas button was removed - research results stay in the assistant conversation. Limits: only light checks were run (Swift parse, two Office embedded-controls checks, four Office ink-bridge checks, the read-only permission fixture, notes bridge, the standalone mode-memory smoke, xcodegen); the App cloud build and full UI/device acceptance remain pending; the build 191 local Qwen GatedDeltaNet first-message abort still needs device confirmation and is not claimed fixed. Video submissions incur real charges - use your own provider credentials. In feedback include device, OS, model and the shortest reproduction.
zh-Hans: Build 197 发布候选（1.7.0，预留标签 v1.7.0-beta.54，标签尚未创建）。App 云端编译、上传与真机验收均未开始，以下是本候选的内部测试说明。请重点测试：① 思维导图：选中主题后点左上角“新增子节点／新增同级节点”应立即创建节点并进入文字编辑，手指与 Apple Pencil 都可；未选主题、对中心主题新增同级或导图仍在保存时应给出提示，新增可撤销并保存。② 视频：video.models 现显示公开模型名，video.generate／canvas.generate 可省略 model，由当前模型在公开候选间自选，不再向你索要 UUID；方舟视频改从正确的密钥存储读取供应商凭据。③ 工具上下文：多次工具调用后重启 App 继续同一会话，模型应记得此前的工具结果（包括跨上下文压缩摘要）；持久化的工具摘要已做敏感信息脱敏。④ 执行环境：设置页显示真实运行时版本并标注内置／远程／用户安装与真实更新状态；apt 安装按路由给出真实签名回执或拒绝原因。⑤ 妙控键盘：聊天输入框无修饰 Return 发送、Shift+Return 换行、输入法组字时 Return 不发送；画布助手软件 Return 仍发送。⑥ Office：既有／导入文档第一次进入为只读预览、第二次起直接编辑，本轮新建的文档首次即直编；IDE 中 Office 内嵌在标签内并有源码管理与分享入口；文件管理器展开 Office 直达全屏编辑器；云端／网络文档为只读快照，下载到本地工作区后才可编辑；Pencil 墨迹设置在重新打开后保持。另：无效的“加入画布”按钮已移除，研究结果只留在助手对话中。限制：本轮只做轻量校验（Swift parse、Office 嵌入适配器 2 项、Office ink bridge 4 项、只读权限夹具、notes bridge、Office mode-memory 独立 smoke、xcodegen），App 云编译与完整 UI／真机验收待后续；Build191 本地 Qwen GatedDeltaNet 首次消息崩溃仍待真机确认，尚未证实修复。视频提交会真实计费，请使用自己的供应商凭据。反馈请带设备、系统、模型与最短复现步骤。
